title: Amazon FBA Profit, ROI & Break-Even ACOS Calculator
meta_description: Calculate Amazon FBA net profit per unit, referral fees, FBA fulfillment and storage costs, ROI, net margin, and break-even PPC ACOS.
lead: Evaluate Amazon product viability in seconds—see true net profit per unit, ROI on landed cost, and exact break-even ACOS.

inputs.label: Target PPC Spend / TACoS (% of Sales)

formula_html:
Break-Even ACOS = (Sale Price - Landed Cost - Prep - Referral Fee - FBA Fee - Storage) / Sale Price.

ROI = Net Profit / (Landed Cost + Prep Cost).

faqs.q: What is a good break-even ACOS on Amazon FBA?
faqs.a: Experienced private-label sellers usually aim for a pre-ad margin (break-even ACOS) of 30%–45% so sponsored product ads remain profitable during launch and steady-state ranking.

faqs.q: Should I enter ACoS or TACoS?
faqs.a: For unit-level profitability across all orders (organic + PPC), enter your TACoS (total ad spend divided by total revenue). For pure PPC-attributed orders, enter your target ACoS.
